- **`_convert_dict_to_message`** mapping user→`HumanMessage`, assistant→`AIMessage`, system→`SystemMessage`, function→`FunctionMessage`.

**`langchain_groq/__init__.py`** — exports `ChatGroq`, `__all__ = ["ChatGroq"]`.
